citation.title: Clinical performance, accuracy, and physical-mechanical properties of 3D-printed removable partial denture metal frameworks compared with conventionally and partially digitally produced frameworks: A systematic review
citation.authors: Ahmed Yaseen Alqutaibi, Redhwan Saleh Al-Gabri, Anas Saeed Al-Zaghruri, Ahmed E. Farghal, Ahmed A. Alnazzawi, Mohammed Ahmed Alghauli

s_design.anchor: Systematic review without meta-analysis of predominantly in-vitro studies plus a few clinical trials (MATERIAL SR/MA row, 100). Classified MATERIAL by its primary aim of fit, accuracy and physical-mechanical properties; clinical outcomes are secondary.
s_design.evidence_quote: Thirty studies were included: 12 compared 3D printing technologies with conventional casting

domains.evidence_quote: This study received no funding and was registered with PROSPERO
domains.note: PROSPERO CRD42024597225 is stated in the abstract and in Methods 2.1.

domains.evidence_quote: literature search was conducted in the PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Cochrane databases in October 2024
domains.note: Four bibliographic databases are searched, so the 3b-i threshold of 2 is met. Methods 2.3 also reports two independent reviewers, no language restriction, search terms in Table S1 and reference-list and journal hand-searching.

domains.evidence_quote: although three records[42–44] were excluded because
domains.note: The full-text exclusions are identified by citation [42–44] and share one specific, checkable reason: they did not evaluate the 3D-printed metal framework RPD. The counts (31 retrieved + 2 added, 30 included) show these three are all of the full-text exclusions. This meets 3b-iii item 1.

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.evidence_quote: The risk of bias was assessed using appropriate tools (modified CONSORT, ROB2, and ROBINS-I)
domains.note: Methods 2.4 says two authors assessed risk of bias, with a third consulted on disagreement. Results are reported per study in 3.3.

domains.evidence_quote: was not performed because of the considerable variability across
domains.note: No pooling was done. The decision not to pool is affirmatively justified by heterogeneity in framework type, material, technology, layer thickness, supports and orientation, and a qualitative descriptive synthesis was used instead.

Absence protocol applied. Sections read: Methods 2.1-2.5, Results 3.1-3.4, Discussion including the GRADE paragraph, and Conclusions. No publication bias, reporting bias, small-study effect or funnel plot wording appears anywhere. The GRADE paragraph lists study design, risk of bias, inconsistency, indirectness and imprecision, and omits publication bias. This instrument offers no not-applicable rating for the no-meta-analysis case, and under FULL_TEXT silence rates high.

penalties.evidence_quote: The authors declare that they have no known competing
penalties.note: A competing-interest declaration is present. The funding statement reads 'This systematic review did not receive any funding.'

penalties.item: clinical trial not prospectively registered (RCTs only)
penalties.note: Not applicable: this is a systematic review, not an RCT, and its own protocol was registered.

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis
penalties.note: not applicable to a secondary study

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires
penalties.note: Does not fire. The review makes no survival or longevity claim of its own, and its text states no follow-up duration to judge against. It only names long-term clinical comparison as a literature gap. The claims are about fit, accuracy, mechanical properties, retention and satisfaction.

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز DES این systematic review برابر ۵۵ از ۱۰۰ است و در باند C (شواهد محدود) با نوع سؤال MATERIAL قرار می‌گیرد.
sources.interpretation_fa: این مرور پروتکل ثبت‌شده و ارزیابی risk of bias دارد، اما publication bias را بررسی نکرده است. ۲۶ مطالعه از ۳۰ in-vitro هستند، پس ارزش اصلی آن در مقایسه‌ی fit، accuracy و خواص مکانیکی فریم‌ورک‌های SLM و DMLS است. GRADE برای fit بالینی و retention moderate و برای دقت و خواص مکانیکی low تا extremely low است.
